displayName: ElderGuard: cold start outside a deploy

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "__SERVICE__" AND logName = "projects/__PROJECT__/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Fvarlog%2Fsystem" AND textPayload : "Starting new instance" AND NOT textPayload : "DEPLOYMENT_ROLLOUT"

documentation.content: Cloud Run started an instance for a reason other than a deploy (idle scale-down, platform restart, or crash). A Twilio call arriving during that start can miss the 15 s webhook timeout. Check the `startup_timing` log line of the new instance, and whether the every-minute sweep job is still running (it keeps the instance warm while minScale is 0).
